BLACK MOUNTAIN COLLEGE CONCERT
Saturday November 4 1944 8:15 PM
W DE FESCH (d ca 1758)
Sonata in D major for flute cello and piano
Siciliano/ Vivace/ Menuet I/ Menuet II
L BOCCERINI (1743-1805)
Sonata in B-flat major for viola and piano
Allegro meoderato/ Grave/ Minuetto
Intermission
J S BACH (1685-1750)
Sonata in E major for violin and piano
Adagio/ Allegro/ Adagio ma non tanto/ Allegro
A VIVALDI (1680-1743)
Concerto grosso in D minor for two violins and piano
Allegro/ Largo/ Allegro
LORNA PEARSON flute
TRUDI STRAUS Violin
GRETEL LOWINSKY Violin and Viola
ANNA SCHAUFFLER Cello
HEINRICH JALOWETZ Piano
EDWARD LOWINSKY Piano
